messages:
Mira: deploy-bot alerted: edge-proxy (ap-southeast-1) TLS handshakes failing ~12:15 UTC during cert rotator run. Logs show KMS Decrypt AccessDenied. Rolling back certs gave brief recovery. Anyone remember RBAC change to rotator role? @Devon @Linh

Devon: looking. I see a terraform PR merged 05:03 UTC that removed kms:Decrypt from service/rotator role for apac-perf. Reverting now. PR: https://git.internal/r/3456

Linh: grabbing CloudTrail + KMS audit. Also check keystore replicas — the rotator uses cross-region KMS key alias arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:111111:key/abc123. Could be key policy or condition blocking assumed-role.

Devon: repro snippet from rotator logs:
```
2026-06-01T05:15:12Z rotator ERROR KMS:Decrypt AccessDenied KeyId=arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:111111:key/abc123
caused by principal arn:aws:sts::111111:assumed-role/rotator-role/rotator-session
```
Suspect the recent role split tightened a condition on SourceAccount.

Mira: runbook says fallback to local keystore if KMS unavailable, but we didn't enable fallback for ap-southeast. Can we enable prefix cache + fallback for ingress so handshakes don't fail during KMS blips?

Linh: short checklist I'll follow: audit logs (CloudTrail + KMS) to capture failures; RBAC diff -> revert PR or relax condition; ensure rotator preflight validates key policy; enable graceful fallback to file keystore with soft TTL. I'll open a quick PR to restore kms:Decrypt and add alerting.

ops-bot: Canary rollback executed by @Devon at 05:22 UTC :white_check_mark:

Devon: reverted PR and re-ran rotator. Edge handshakes recovered. We should add a unit test that simulates KMS deny. Rather than fail-open policy, prefer local encrypted cache + strong TTL and an observability signal.

Mira: also planning TLS hardening follow-up: enforce TLS1.3 where possible, drop RSA key-exchange, require ECDHE, prefer AEAD ciphers. But watch outbound EU partners that still use TLS1.2 — need region-aware handshake profiles.

Linh: agreed. Action items: 1) short-term: revert RBAC + enable keystore fallback (PR #789), 2) med-term: rotator preflight KMS key policy validation + implement cached local key with soft TTL, 3) long-term: TLS profile matrix per region + document fallback policy and KMS-deny audit events. I'll add tasks and assign owners.

Mira: filing incident INC-20260601-rotator-kms. Audit shows 12:15-12:22 window ~420 failures, attaching traces.

Devon: quick vuln-triage note: no evidence of leaked certs; rotator secrets are rotated. We should scan terraform state for leaked keys. Happy to run the postmortem. :thumbsup:

security-bot: automated note: CloudTrail event IDs attached. :lock:

Mira: will close once PR merged and alerting in place. :eyes:
